name: uncorked_creeps_pay_defender
description: Defending pays (design 1.4): seat 1 uncorks the Gourd Rush in wave 2 onto seat 2's road, where seat 2's towers kill all six. Each one dies to seat 2's towers on hollow 1 and pays seat 2 a Gourdling's bounty of 3 (the bounty goes to the hollow's team, the defender's), 18 in all; seat 1, the sender, is paid nothing for them (no breach).

steps.assert: fates == ['died to seat 2 for 3', 'died to seat 2 for 3', 'died to seat 2 for 3', 'died to seat 2 for 3', 'died to seat 2 for 3', 'died to seat 2 for 3']
steps.msg: all six Gourdlings died to seat 2's towers, each worth 3

steps.assert: scene.gold_to(2, 'bounty') == scene.bounty_on(1) and scene.gold_to(1, 'bounty') == scene.bounty_on(0) and scene.bounty_on(1) - scene.bounty_on(0) >= 18
steps.msg: every death on seat 2's road paid seat 2, the pack's 18 among them; seat 1 was paid only for deaths on its own
the sender gets nothing for creeps the defender killed
